feeds.title: Nora Cooks Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nora. Whether you are new or have been around for a while, I'm so glad you're here. I share vegan recipes that are easy to make and even easier to eat. I have a big focus on family-friendly comfort foods but also share healthier recipes like lentil soup.

feeds.title: Healthy Happy Life
feeds.description: Kathy Patalsky is a content creator, artist and author. Kathy founded the recipe and vegan lifestyle blog, HealthyHappyLife.com est. 2007. Kathy is the author and photographer of two cookbooks, 365 Vegan Smoothies and Healthy Happy Vegan Kitchen.

feeds.title: Sweet Potato Soul
feeds.description: A vegan food and lifestyle blog, cookbook, and cooking show! Featuring easy, delicious, and healthy vegan recipes. Hi, I'm Jenné! On Sweet Potato Soul you'll discover hundreds of delicious and easy-to-make vegan recipes. I also share lots of cooking videos and healthy eating tips.

feeds.title: Vegan Mom
feeds.description: I am Anna. With my blog, I want to show that vegan food is a colorful, tasty, healthy, and wholesome form of nutrition and I would like to encourage and offer support to those of you who still shy away from changing your diet.

feeds.title: Vegan Family Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: My name is Brigitte Gemme and this is my Vegan Family Kitchen. I create the resources you can find on this website - many available for free! - because I am passionate about spreading the vegan food love.

feeds.title: Vegetarian Mamma » Vegan Recipes
feeds.description: Find delicious and easy-to-make vegan recipes here. We have taken classic comfort foods and we have turned them into tasty vegan recipes! Hi, I'm Cindy! I create delicious vegetarian and vegan recipes that are free from gluten! We love cooking with our Air Fryer, Instant Pot, and more!

feeds.title: The VegaNatural Mom
feeds.description: My name is Aydela and I'm married and have a 1-year-old princess, Haylee. I've been vegan for almost 4 years now and my motivation is my love for animals. In my blog, you will find many helpful tips and guides on the topic of veganism, specifically how it relates to being a mom.

feeds.title: Fried Dandelions Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah, Welcome to my corner of the internet, where I share kid-tested, family-friendly, plant-based vegan recipes with an allergy-safe spin. Here you'll get a variety of delicious recipes for breakfast, dessert, lunch, and more.

feeds.title: Vegan Kids Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karla Moreno-Bryce, a vegan Registered Dietitian that supports moms to help their kids grow and develop well on a vegan diet. As a mom myself, it's important to me to support vegan moms just like you in feeling confident and proud of following a vegan diet for compassion for animals.

feeds.title: Bohemian Vegan Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Randi. I'm a vegan recipe developer, food photographer, and author of Bohemian Vegan Kitchen. I'm also a full-time wifey, mom, and homeschooler of three amazing kiddos. Browse hundreds of delicious vegan comfort food recipes and even something a little healthier. With detailed step-by-step photos and expert tips, every recipe is doable, regardless of your cooking experience!

feeds.title: Living with Warmth Blog
feeds.description: Vegan Family Guide covers all aspects of lifestyle, learning, and leisure- from an ethical angle. I provide comprehensive information, which is readable and simply organized, based on my own experience as a vegan mother.

feeds.title: Vegan Mommy Dee
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Debbie and I'm an inked Vegan mom to many, a lover of black coffee, and owls & I've been told I'm a bit of a health nut. I've lost 80 lbs on my health and fitness journey! I create easy healthy vegan recipes for everyone to enjoy! Healthy food CAN taste fantastic!

feeds.title: Mom Vegan Love
feeds.description: Mom Vegan Love - for your health, for our planet, for every living being blog is by Kristine who is a mom of 3 and shares her daily vegan life.
